topic: invalidate old keys after moving into a new home
core_question: How do I make sure previous owners' keys no longer work after I move in?
answer_summary: Have a locksmith rekey the existing lock cylinders (swap the internal pins) so old keys stop working and new keys are issued, without replacing the whole lock.
